mentions.h: From THE BELGRAVIAN ..... 25 years ago .... & 40 years ago ....

photos.c: The start of the Belgrave Youths 3 miles Championship L. to R. --- 'Noddy' Edwards(2nd), R.Nelson (8th), J.Bicourt(1st), R.Hayes (3rd), J.Leaver (4th), B.Merry (5th), F.Clark (6th), and J.Chandler, partly hidden, (7th).

TOP LEFT: Bill Kerr trails Bullivant and Tulloh on Stage 9. TOP RIGHT: John Thresher hands over to a determined Trevor Hart after stage 2. CENTRE: Alan Mead and 'Noddy' Edwards, with some female assistance, cheer on the runners! BOTTOM LEFT: Laurie O'Hara hands over to Gerry North after chopping 17 secs off the Club record for stage 7. BOTTOM RIGHT: Alan Black brings Belgrave home in 4th place.

share.d: 'Noddy' Edwards in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1963–2006: 6 mentions in 5 issues, 2 race results and 2 photographs.
